scope: Varenholm Gate romance eligibility and playback; isolated state scenarios, not full playthroughs

menus.declineLabel: Not now. Not with the city ahead of us.
Not now. Not with the city ahead of us.

writing.name: Santiago
writing.description: A squire of the Order of the Dawning Flame, from its chapter house in the sun-lands, on his first errand. Earnest, rigid, secretly terrified of failing.

q9_romance.t: [stumbling] I have written this out four times and burned it three. I — {target}. With respect. I have not stopped looking at you since the wolves, and I am not the sort who looks.
[earnest] If the Order asks, I will say it was duty. It was not.

q9_romance_yes.t: [overwhelmed] Truly? I — yes. Yes. God keep you. I will be very good at this — I will try very hard to be good at this, I promise.

q9_romance_no.t: [bravely] Then I am glad I said it, and I will not say it again. Thank you for hearing it.

epilogue.line: Santiago asked you to attend his knighting. You did. The Order pretended not to notice you.
epilogue.favoured: He calls it the right ending. He calls everything the right ending. This time you agree with him.

writing.name: Itsuki
writing.description: An elf ranger of the eastern woods who has hunted the bandit lord Gorruk for a year. Grief made him quiet; the quiet made him precise.

q9_romance.t: [low] I buried the last person I loved beside a road. I said I would not do this again.
[quiet] I would, though. With you. I wanted you to know it before the city, in case the city is the end of me.

q9_romance_yes.t: [exhaling] Then I will try to live through the city. That is new. Thank you for giving me a reason.

q9_romance_no.t: [calm] I understand. It was enough to say it. Sleep.

epilogue.line: Itsuki sleeps through the night now. He says it is the tree. You suspect it is not the tree.
epilogue.favoured: He said "mine" once more, at the altar, and then never again. He did not need to.

writing.name: Layla
writing.description: A dark-elf priestess of the deep cities, fleeing her own people and a bounty. Contemptuous, curious, thinks mercy is a luxury the strong buy.

q9_romance.t: [dry] Do not look so alarmed. I am not asking you to love me; your people are terrible at it.
[soft] I am telling you that I have decided to stay, and that when you sit in that chair I mean to be standing beside it. By the deep, make of that what you will.

q9_romance_yes.t: [satisfied] Good. You will not regret it, and if you do, I will mend that.

q9_romance_no.t: [shrugging] As you like. The offer keeps. I am patient in a way your kind is not.

epilogue.line: Layla sleeps in the chapel and, when it suits her, elsewhere. She is very clear that it suits her.
epilogue.favoured: She was standing beside the chair when you sat in it. She has not stopped smiling. It is not a warm smile. It is yours.

writing.name: Kaito
writing.description: An elf bounty-hunter of the eastern woods who flirts with anything and finishes every job. Cheerful, mercenary, surprisingly loyal.

q9_romance.t: [smiling] So. I flirt with everything. Trees. Wyverns. That doorman. You have noticed.
[suddenly serious] Forgive me. I have not meant a word of it since the web. I mean this one. Tell me to stop, or tell me not to.

q9_romance_yes.t: [delighted] Do not stop. Understood. Written down. Framed.
[soft] Thank you. I will be insufferable about this for years.

q9_romance_no.t: [light] Stop it is. Friends, then, and I am very good at that as well.

epilogue.line: Kaito still flirts with everything. He says it is professional courtesy. He comes home to one door.
epilogue.favoured: The Undervault knows his face now, and yours, and treats you both as family. Tunde says that is the debt, paid.

writing.name: Amara
writing.description: Kolade's lover and sword-hand. A monk of the Gate's fire temples who wants him stopped, not slaughtered. Grave, exact, tired.

q9_romance.t: [quiet] I loved a man who wanted to be a god. I am not proud of it, and I am not sorry for it.
[steady] I do not know what I want from you. I know that when you kept your word at the gate, something in me turned toward you the way a plant turns to a window. Say something, or do not.

q9_romance_yes.t: [exhaling] Then we will find out what it is together. After the altar. If there is an after.

q9_romance_no.t: [calm] That is fair. I have asked enough of you for one life. The altar, then.

epilogue.line: Amara brings bread to the cell every week. You walk her there and wait outside. She has never once asked you to come in.
epilogue.favoured: She said you kept your word. She said it as if it were the strangest thing anyone had ever done for her.
